title: Late-life psychiatry: depression, late psychosis and capacity

steps.tx: **Late-life psychiatry** covers mental illness after 60 years with more physical comorbidity and 3 times suicide risk. About 15 percent of 100 elders show depression at 6 months follow up. **Geriatric depression** often hides behind pain, 5 drugs and bereavement in 2 years. Clear history from patient plus informant over 10 minutes best separates grief from illness.
steps.say: Late life psychiatry covers mental illness after sixty years with more physical comorbidity and three times suicide risk. steps.tx: **Vascular depression** follows small vessel disease and white matter change in 30 percent of 200 cases. Hypothyroid, 12 drug use, anaemia and 2 brain strokes drive onset after 65 years. **Bereavement** within 6 months doubles risk in widowers of 75 years. Treating 1 medical cause within 4 weeks often lifts mood as much as 2 drugs alone.

steps.tx: **Late schizophrenia** starts after 40 years with paranoid delusions and hallucination in 5 percent of new cases. Sensory loss, isolation and 3 months stress bring onset at 68 years. **Dopamine** excess plus sensory change fuels voices heard as whispers in 1 ear. Brain **atrophy** on 1 scan may mimic disease, so 2 repeat scans 6 months apart help.

steps.tx: **Late onset depression** brings somatic worry, poor sleep for 3 weeks and 5 kg weight loss. Patients 72 years old voice 2 wishes for death with plans kept secret. **Anhedonia** and 1 slow response mark severity over tearfulness alone. Spotting 15 percent hidden suicide risk in 6 months needs 4 direct questions about intent and 7 day means.

steps.tx: **Capacity** means the ability to understand, retain, weigh 2 options and communicate over 1 decision. Assess 4 domains in 15 minutes with family present in 80 percent cases. Use **Mental Capacity Act** 2 stage test for 70 year olds facing hip surgery in 24 hours. Document verbatim the 3 key facts the patient repeats back correctly.

Use the two stage test for seventy year olds facing hip surgery in one day. Document verbatim the three key facts the patient repeats back correctly.

steps.tx: First line **Sertraline** 50 mg daily and **Mirtazapine** 15 mg at night help 60 percent by 6 weeks. **Escitalopram** 10 mg suits 75 year olds with 2 cardiac drugs. Avoid **Paroxetine** 20 mg in 80 year olds because 12 percent get withdrawal. Review at 2 weeks, then 4 weekly checks for 8 weeks in 100 clinic visits.

steps.tx: **Testamentary capacity** uses **Banks v Goodfellow** 4 limbs: estate, claims, nature of act and illness effect. Test in 30 minutes with 2 witnesses in 90 year olds writing 1 will. **Aripiprazole** 5 mg may clear 1 psychosis enough for assessment. Record estate value, 3 family claims and 1 diagnosis to survive court challenge in 5 years.

steps.tx: **ECT** lifts melancholic depression in 70 percent within 4 sessions over 2 weeks. Suicide in elders 80 years reaches 15 per 100000 each year in 3 districts. **Elder abuse** hides in 10 percent needing 1 safe interview alone. Watch 6 weekly drug levels because 2 fold rise of **Lithium** 0.8 mmol predicts delirium in 1 day.

steps.tx: **Pseudodementia** lifts 3 points on MoCA 30 within 4 weeks of antidepressants in 60 percent. **Early dementia** keeps near misses for 8 months with poor insight. **Donepezil** 10 mg helps true dementia but fails pseudodementia in 2 months. Ask 5 dont know answers and 2 week mood history to split the 2 states in 10 minutes.

steps.tx: High-yield trim: treat **Sertraline** 50 mg or **Mirtazapine** 15 mg for 6 weeks in late depression. Test **capacity** over 4 domains in 15 minutes with 2 stage rule. Use **Banks v Goodfellow** 4 limbs for wills with 2 witnesses. Offer **ECT** for 70 percent melancholic cases within 2 weeks when drugs fail.
